concerns.text: FR-011 (replicate check) and FR-012 (environmental metadata exclusion) lack explicit implementation tasks. T015 mentions the logic but is marked 'Depends on T014' and T014 is 'Depends on T012/T005'. T007 (schema) and T008 (env management) are marked 'missing artifacts' but not remediated. No task explicitly implements the 'exclude if <3 replicates' or 'exclude if missing temp/light' logic as a standalone, testable unit.

FR-008 (overlap statistics) and SC-003 (overlap proportion) rely on T031, which is marked 'failed/rejected' with no remediation. T016 (pathway aggregation) is also failed, blocking T031. No task exists to implement the overlap calculation logic or the descriptive statistic reporting required by FR-008.

FR-005 (5-fold CV) and SC-001/SC-002 (R²/RMSE) rely on T021 (Nested k-Fold) and T023 (metrics). T021 is implemented, but T023 (calculate/report metrics) is marked 'rejected' with no remediation. T022 (leakage prevention) is also rejected. No task ensures imputation parameters are fitted only on training folds, violating FR-005's statistical rigor.

FR-010 (multiple-comparison correction) and SC-005 (FDR) rely on T030 (Benjamini-Hochberg). T030 is marked 'implemented' but T028 (permutation importance) is 'failed'. T031 (overlap) is failed. T032 (final report) and T033 (stability) are also failed. No task exists to generate the final JSON report with disclaimers and FDR values as required by FR-009 and FR-010.

FR-009 (associational disclaimer) requires injection into all reports. T025 (inject disclaimer) is marked 'rejected'. T032 (final report) is also rejected. No task ensures the disclaimer is present in `model_metrics.json`, `interpretation_report.json`, or `data_validation_report.json`.

T007 and T008 are marked 'missing artifacts' but remain in the 'Foundational' phase without being moved to a 'Re-do' state or linked to a remediation task. This creates a false sense of progress and blocks the 'Independent Test' criteria for US1.

T016 and T017 are marked 'failed' but remain in the 'Implementation' list without remediation. T016 (pathway aggregation) is not explicitly required by the spec (FR-008 only requires overlap stats), but T017 (validation report) is required by US1's acceptance scenario 3. No task exists to generate the validation report.

T022, T023, T024, T025 are marked 'rejected' but remain in the 'Implementation' list. T024 (save model) is required for T025 and T028. No task exists to save the model artifact or generate the metrics JSON.

T028, T031, T032, T033 are marked 'failed' or 'rejected' but remain in the 'Implementation' list. T028 (permutation importance) is required for T030 (FDR). T031 (overlap) is required for FR-008. T032 (final report) is required for FR-009/FR-010. T033 (stability) is required for SC-004. No tasks exist to implement these.
